defect.evidence_quote: Applying these principles, we. hold that it is not “unreasonable” for police, as part of the routine procedure incident to incarcerating an arrested person, to search any container or article in his possession, in accordance with established inventory procedures.
defect.locator_note: content_page.md frontmatter holding; cached opinion text paragraph b692-6 at page 648.
defect.problem: The holding field is truncated and materially incomplete. It ends at “in an…” and omits the opinion’s limiting terms that the container or article be in the arrestee’s possession and searched in accordance with established inventory procedures.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace the holding with: As part of the routine procedure incident to incarcerating an arrested person, police may search any container or article in the arrestee's possession, in accordance with established inventory procedures.
